# AI API 公益站与 Token 中转站导航

Chinese directory of public-benefit and low-cost AI API relay services.

Keywords: AI API 公益站, Token 中转站, API 中转站, 免费 API, 低价 API, OpenAI API, GPT API, Claude API, Codex API, Grok API, Gemini API, DeepSeek API, New API, One API, CC Switch.

Primary human-readable directory: README.md
Structured site data: data/sites.json
Contribution and verification policy: CONTRIBUTING.md

Status notes are time-sensitive. A reachable registration page does not guarantee successful registration, current model availability, free quota, price, reliability, or data security. Never publish API keys, cookies, account credentials, session tokens, or private URLs in this repository.
